title: Maximum number of storeys
text: C3.2.1 Building height complies with Table 3.2a. Table 3.2a Maximum building heights, maximum number of storeys: R2-R35 2; R40-R60 3.

replaces.note: Part B had no storey limit; 2 storeys new for R10-R25 (C4P1-071)
wall height and roof-type metrics deleted
R40 2 -> 3 storeys (C4P1-073); R30-R35 2 and R50-R60 3 unchanged (C4P1-072, C4P1-074)

verified.note: Values clear; lower row printed 'R2-R35'. Table 4A (p7) agrees: 2 storeys R10-R35, 3 storeys R40-R60.

notes: from: ch3 C3.2.1#storeys. R10-R35 2 storeys, R40-R60 3 storeys (Table 3.2a p28; Table 4A p7). 'Storey' per A1 (a mansard counts where its vertical height exceeds 2.4 m, C4P1-071). No four-storey option at R50-R60 (C4P1-074). proposal.storeys is used; building.storeys is the same count from the elevations.
